intrinsic_thermal_measure_diagnostic.method: Original gpu_reference.intrinsic(binary,_CaptureMesh(level)); original finite face temperatures unchanged. For each parent angular face sum duffy_nodes(order4) weights times RocheGeometry.sample radial Jacobian. Report sum(T^4*A)/(Teff^4*sum(A))-1 for original corrected faceted and curved areas. Both area measures are in SMA squared; original areas independently agree with direct original triangle_areas(faces,points). No reflection, radiance or LD; no renormalization is applied.
intrinsic_thermal_measure_diagnostic.limit: CPU-only finite diagnostic, not complete reflected energy balance, a continuous thermal solution, causal field-error isolation, or an implementation parity test.

Generic.Bessell.V.limit: Coupled finite field/patch-basis change at matched dyadic leaf scale; not a causal field-error isolation.

geometry_and_fields.conditioned_shadow: Same originalpotential and outergradient with local primary/secondary coordinates. Twelve stationary Newton iterations retain positive-derivative, displacement and64eps*|gradient| residual guards. No unit-centre addition/subtraction inside tangency iterations. Signed shadow margin uses target minus actual stationary potential; its zero is the silhouette even when tangency offset is nonzero.
geometry_and_fields.boundary: Original sevenprobe/two-spread/diameter band plus fixed bounded extra topology subdivision. Bracketed implicit limb and shadow edge roots define finite leaf chords in barycentric plane. Two sequential polygon clips and parent-preserving triangulation, then true Roche Duffy quadrature. Shadow masks are not reapplied at quadrature nodes. Nonpositive true limb cosines contribute zero.
geometry_and_fields.finite_limit: Straight leaf chords approximate the curved boundary. Edge bisection brackets are not chord-error bounds. Probes cannot certify absence of every sub-probe contour. Topology/resource exhaustion aborts. No interval or continuum certificate.
geometry_and_fields.fields: Fresh original corrected finite thermal, irradiation, radiance andLD fields remain piecewise constant per angular parent face. Original build order/reflection/atmosphere semantics retained; fields rebuilt each candidate. No continuous-field or bolometric energy-closure qualification with the curved measure.
geometry_and_fields.field_boundary_coupling: Changing parent grid changes angular basis as well as field values. Field1-depth4 versus field2-depth3 matches dyadic leaf scale but is a coupled finite control, not pure field-error isolation.
geometry_and_fields.hybrid: True geometry, adaptation, conditioned shadow solves and clipping are common freshCPU bridges. CPU reference uses original per-element flux and finite fields/reflection/radiance; device path uses preceding corrected-state/reflection/BB and weightedLD integration kernels. CK04 explicitlyCPU radiance. No allGPU claim or cache of physical predictions.
geometry_and_fields.domain: Circular detached unspotted/nonpulsating q[.5,2],spin[.5,1.5],inner radius1e-6..0.25 plus explicit geometric/residual guards. Fieldlevels0-2,max20276parents/star,orders2-4,depth0-7,edgebisections32-48(default36),topologydepth0-4(default4),max2097152quadrature nodes/star/phase,1-8bands,1-128phases. Nodecap is not a peakmemory bound. Numerical failures are not prior cuts; originalCPU/generalfallback routes unchanged.

validation_and_science.oracle: Same new boundary-fitted rule with independent originalCPU finite fields/reflection/radiance and elementflux arithmetic. Differences from original faceted whole curves are separately labelled numerical-method changes. Existing3e-13relative raw/component and3e-13/2e-12normalized parity gates unchanged.
validation_and_science.independent_controls: Extended-precision unchanged originalgradient/potential comparisons in local smallstar coordinates; independent scalarBrent line tangencies; closedform opaque sphere/disk overlaps for partial/grazing/total; analytic linearLD disk integrals; unchanged preceding radius/Jacobian/area controls. Sphere overlap target5e-6 at depth5 was fixed independently from CPU/GPU differences.
validation_and_science.resolved_conditioning: Previously rejected potentials[8,100] case now completes under unchanged stationary residual guard, with complete CPU/GPU curves and unchanged originalCPU before/after controls. Local equation/shadow tests at much higher potentials do not qualify complete curves in that extended regime.
validation_and_science.resolved_cpu_topology_probe: First finerCPUprofile stopped at unresolved sampled topology. A fixed bounded extra-subdivision rule resolves it without changing the oracle/parity/accuracy gates. Failed private evidence retained. Exhaustion remains explicit; probe coverage is not a continuum proof.
validation_and_science.inference: Matched original prediction/density callbacks include serializers/constraints, priors, phase/JD reducers/repeats, thirdlight, finalmean and originalnoise law. Numerical budgets use nominalsigma independently ln_f, outside candidate penalties. Data-dependent finite logL bound includes residual cross term. No registered boundaryfit/sampler backend, optimizedfit, convergence orESS claim.
validation_and_science.accuracy: Finite depth/order/field comparisons measure only computed pairs. Area/parity or a passing finite boundary pair cannot certify an uncomputed boundary or continuous fields. Continuous-field error and complete1e-4posterior qualification remain open.

timing_conditions.curves: Matched constructor plus wholecurve, fresh finite fields, commonCPUgeometry/adaptation/clipping, integration, alltransfers and raw/normalized/component hostoutputs. Same unit/affinity0-15/Nice10/threads1/FP64. Compilation incurred included; shapes/source caches can warm. Single observations, not throughput distributions.
timing_conditions.callbacks: Both reference and selected timers begin before physical serialization/constraints and constructor, then originalprior, same originalpredict_light_curves callback with prepare_binary/phase mapping, and density. Numerical coarsepreflight and extra independentcontrols add to mainwall. Equal contracts replace preceding unmatched prepared-binary subtimers.
timing_conditions.startup: Mainwall after imports; commandwall includes Python/import startup. Unitprobe, pause and restoration separate. CPUdeveloper timings while production runs excluded from matched performance evidence.
timing_conditions.inference: CPUgeometry remains a bridge and accuracy stops remain required. No qualified fitting/MCMC/ESS speedup can be inferred.
